quarantined_leads.source_title: Stockbridge mayor’s messages with high school student detailed in police report
quarantined_leads.subject_response: Williams’s attorney Robert Kenner Jr. said the student was 18, was not part of the mentorship program, and that the communication occurred before Williams became mayor. Williams says some city-card charges were accidental and were repaid immediately, while other purchases were made without his awareness that they were improper. Police found no evidence of criminal activity involving Williams; a city investigative hearing is scheduled for September 12, 2026.
